description: This file defines the DelegationCredentialRepository class for managing delegation credentials, including creation, retrieval, updating, and deletion, with encryption/decryption of service account keys and handling of related organization members.

classes.name: DelegationCredentialRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing delegation credentials, including CRUD operations and related logic.

methods.name: doesEmailMatchDelegationCredentialDomain
methods.description: Checks if a member email matches the delegation credential's email domain.

methods.name: decryptServiceAccountKey
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted service account key.

methods.name: withParsedServiceAccountKey
methods.description: Parses and decrypts the service account key within a delegation credential object.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new delegation credential record.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Finds a delegation credential by its ID.

methods.name: findUniqueByOrganizationIdAndDomainIncludeSensitiveServiceAccountKey
methods.description: Finds a delegation credential by organization ID and domain, including sensitive service account key.

methods.name: findByIdIncludeSensitiveServiceAccountKey
methods.description: Finds a delegation credential by ID, including sensitive service account key.

methods.name: findUniqueByOrgMemberEmailIncludeSensitiveServiceAccountKey
methods.description: Finds a delegation credential by organization member email, including sensitive service account key.

methods.name: findAllByDomain
methods.description: Finds all delegation credentials matching a domain.

methods.name: updateById
methods.description: Updates a delegation credential by ID.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes a delegation credential by ID.

methods.name: findByOrgIdIncludeSensitiveServiceAccountKey
methods.description: Finds all delegation credentials for an organization, including sensitive service account key.

methods.name: findAllEnabledIncludeDelegatedMembers
methods.description: Finds all enabled delegation credentials with delegated members included.

methods.name: findAllDisabledAndIncludeNextBatchOfMembersToProcess
methods.description: Finds all disabled delegation credentials with members to process.
